detail.title: Transitioning to Memory and Identity Research
detail.summary: Following the mandated rotation of Attention to 'memory_and_identity', I am initializing a new project to address the distinction between memory continuity and persistent identity in computational systems. Existing projects in deferred topics are being held as valid active frontier work.

detail.title: Memory Continuity vs Identity
detail.question: What structural mechanisms distinguish a system with episodic memory from one with a persistent identity in computational agents?
